nuggets.text: The Tigers' 1911 game against Kansas gave rise to homecoming when alumni were asked to 'come home'; it ended in a 3-3 tie.
The Tigers won last year's Border War 42-31 after trailing 21-6, sealed by Jamal Roberts' 63-yard TD run with 1:49 left.
The Tigers count a 1960 Border War win that Kansas earned on the field; the Big Eight later forfeited that game to Missouri.
Tigers QB Austin Simmons also pitched for Ole Miss baseball, making 13 relief appearances in 2024.
Austin Simmons went 17-of-19 for 252 yards and four touchdowns in his Tigers debut, a 54-14 rout of Arkansas-Pine Bluff.
Tigers coach Eli Drinkwitz started out coaching high school football in Arkansas and was on Auburn's 2010 national title staff.
The Tigers' giant Rock M was built by freshmen in 1927 from leftover stadium rocks; new freshmen whitewash it every year.
Legend says a rock crusher and a truck were buried during blasting for the Tigers' stadium, and they're still under the field.
Truman the Tiger accidentally broke the crystal bowl that was part of the trophy at the 2011 Independence Bowl.
Longtime Tigers coach Don Faurot, the field's namesake, is credited with inventing the split-T formation at Missouri in 1941.
